title: Matterbridge ESPHome Native API plugin
description: Expose ESPHome DIY ESP32/ESP8266 devices to Matter via the ESPHome Native API (port 6053).

devices.title: ESPHome devices
devices.description: List of ESPHome devices to connect to via the Native API.

name.title: Name
name.description: Friendly name prefix for this device.

encryption_key.title: Encryption Key
encryption_key.description: Base64 Noise encryption key from the ESPHome YAML api: encryption: key (optional).

csvPath.title: CSV file path
csvPath.description: Optional path to a CSV file with columns: name,host,port,encryption_key. Devices are merged with the list above.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If empty, all devices are exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Debug only.
